title: IvyWolfArtworkRecord
description: Single artwork record for ivy-wolf.com gallery. Source: PHASE-1.0 schema (master-plan 2026-09-22). buy_enabled is false by default — no buy action ships without PIC word.

technique.description: e.g. High relief, Texture, Flat, Expressionism

dimensions_cm.description: Width × Height in centimetres, e.g. 50×70 cm

dimensions_in.description: Width × Height in inches, e.g. 20×28 in

price_tier.description: Price tier key matching price-list.md, e.g. small_acrylic

poetic_text_en.description: English poetic text written for this piece

poetic_text_es.description: Spanish poetic text written for this piece

alt_text_en.description: English accessibility alt text for the artwork image

alt_text_es.description: Spanish accessibility alt text for the artwork image

image_path.description: Relative path to artwork photograph, e.g. images/works/iw-2025-001.jpg. MISSING until PHASE-5.0.

coa_issued.description: Certificate of Authenticity issued and signed

collection.description: Collection slug, e.g. transmutacion-2025 / bahamas / galapagos

buy_enabled.description: HARD DEFAULT FALSE — no buy surface until PIC gives word. Shopify door is PHASE-6.0.
